_about: Crop, disease and severity names shown in the app. Hindi names were drafted by Claude (AI) and must be reviewed by an agronomist: when an entry is confirmed or corrected, set needs_review to false and put the reviewer and reference in source. Keys match ml-service/data/label_maps.json. docs/TRANSLATION_REVIEW.csv lists everything still to review (npm run translation-review in server/). Punjabi (pa) and Odia (or) names were added on 2026-10-29, drafted by Claude (AI) like the Hindi, and are covered by the same review (also_drafted).
